cause: Fast DV SpToDecent receives sign-extended L=-0 as int16_t -1; its equality check against 15-bit -0 (32767) fails, treating zero as a mixed-sign nonzero and decrementing the high dividend. Existing hardware SimulateDV handles the raw register signs directly.
oracle_choice: Use pinned hardware SimulateDV for every DV. One host-only branch change, no native code or arithmetic linked to either oracle; assembly, rope, pinned checkout and all earlier oracles unchanged.
